title: Unexplored Martian lava tubes

tellings.quote: well on Mars there's a lot of lava tubes that we've never been inside those lava tubes. So what is there inside?

plain: A researcher named Chris Gilbert points out that Mars has many lava tubes, long caves left behind by ancient lava flows, and that no one has ever been inside them. He asks what might be in there, raising the idea that something could be hidden on Mars where we have never looked.
